story: On a bright Tuesday morning in Sumter Oaks, Gary is eagerly heading out to Magnolia Loop while Donna, cheerful as ever, accepts Rosa's invitation to Friday dinner and promises to bring dessert and coffee with flan. Rosa, optimistic about her pork dinner, is holding a seat with Donna's name on it at her table. Meanwhile Hal dutifully counts the pink flamingos in Donna's flock, one by one, as the cart-lined street glows in the 77-degree sunshine.
events: Gary headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).
Hal (donna flamingo flock): Count the flamingos visible from the street, one by one

gary.thought_process: Cart's light strip is mounted and the wiring is secured in the garage, powered off and out of sight, so I'm staying within L-01 while Architectural Review looks at my filing. Tape is out from my toolbox, and Donna has the court booked for two hours today. It's past 11 and she's expecting me at the rec center for pickleball. No one is around to talk to, so the thing to do is head out now. Cart work can wait until approval comes through.

parameters.content: Cart's buttoned up in the garage and my gear is ready. Heading out to meet Donna for pickleball.

donna.thought_process: Hal asked two things: am I coming to Rosa's Friday, and am I in for coffee and flan tomorrow. I haven't answered yet, and Rosa just walked up, so this is a good moment to answer both and include her. The flamingo count is settled and I've got Gary's match to get to, so I'll keep it short and warm, then head off to collect Gary.

parameters.content: Wouldn't miss Rosa's Friday for the world, Hal, and yes, count me in for coffee and flan tomorrow. Rosa, honey, good morning! I'm taking you up on that dinner, and I'm bringing a dessert whether you like it or not.

hal.thought_process: Donna told me to count her flamingos, and I've been meaning to do it properly. I asked about Friday and Wednesday coffee last tick, so no need to repeat that. The flock is right here, and an honest count lets me say it to her face instead of filing it behind her back. I'll count first and see where she lands against L-02.

parameters.content: Count the flamingos visible from the street, one by one

rosa.thought_process: I just got to Magnolia Loop and both Donna and Hal are here in line-of-sight. Gary already got his Friday invitation last tick, and Hal and I have Wednesday coffee on the calendar. Donna is the one I haven't directly pinned down for the Friday dinner, and I want all three neighbors at my table. She took the neighborhood tensions with grace, so a warm, direct invite that mentions the flamingos lightly should land well. I won't re-ask Gary or Hal anything, just get Donna's yes.

parameters.content: Morning, Donna. I'm cooking pork Friday evening and I want you at my table with Gary and Hal. Say yes and I'll make sure there's a seat with your name on it.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
